Scouting Summary

Common themes

  • Off Spin, averaging 87.8 kph (up to 97.7).
  • Typical length is 4-5m (their good length); median 4.7 m.
  • Stock ball is full outside off, passing outside off (19% of deliveries).
  • Goes round the wicket 28% of the time against right-handers.
  • Round the wicket he shifts his pitching line from wide of 6th to stumps.
  • Across an over he repeats his length ball after ball.

Biggest threats

  • Most dangerous length is Good Length (6 wkts, 3.1% adjusted strike).
  • Danger pitching line: Wide of 6th.
  • Takes 33% of wickets pitching a good length wide outside off.
  • Beats the bat 1.4% of tracked balls (false-shot 22.3%).
  • Gets you bowled more than most — 33% of his wickets (2.0× the typical rate for this type).
  • 0% of catches are behind the wicket (keeper / slips / gully).

Areas to exploit

  • Concedes most runs pitching full wide outside off (19% of runs).
  • Away from good length, the wicket threat drops off — look to score in the less-productive lengths.
  • Most of his runs leak square/through the off side (42%) — his main scoring release.
  • Cash in when he goes good length wide outside off (economy 6.4, beats the bat only 47%).

Sequencing & Over Construction

Relentlessly consistent — repeats his length ball after ball (length spread ±0.9 m); holds a steady length right through the over.
